meta_description:
481 likes, 15 comments - cosmoindia on October 30, 2026: "Despite the many projects she has on the go, Kubbra Sait (@kubbrasait) carves out a fortnight every year that’s just for her to push her boundaries physically and mentally. “In the larger scheme of things, a fortnight seems insignificant but it really has changed my life. I do things that I’ve never done before and the learnings I come back with give me the fuel and calm that I need to survive the rest of the year.” She’s scaled Mount Kilimanjaro (Uhuru Peak) in Tanzania, rafted down the Siang in Arunachal Pradesh and gone scuba diving in the Great Barrier Reef in Australia.

Read her full interview at the link in bio!

Editor: Snigdha Ahuja (@snigdha.ahuja)
Interview: Karishma Upadhyay (@karishmaupadhyay)
Photographer: Sushant Chhabria (@sushantchhabria)
Stylist: Zoha Castelino (@zohacastelino)
Make-up Artist: Arleen Gonsalves (@arleen_gonsalves)
Hair Artist: Ishitaa Pahuja (@eetle.beetle)
Editorial Coordinator: Shalini Kanojia (@shalinikanojia)
Assistant Stylist: Aayushi Vaidya (@runwayrecess)
Artist PR Agency: Idhyah Media (@idhyahmedia)

On Kubbra Sait: Outfit, Gabriela Hearst (@gabrielahearst); jewellery, Miss Jo (@missjojewellery)
